name: clips
description: Automatic game recording and clipping with a private libobs capture engine
author: jss

scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.js src scripts test clips-worker/src clips-worker/scripts
scripts.stage:runtime: npm run stage:obs && npm run stage:libobs && npm run stage:ffmpeg && npm run stage:mpv && npm run stage:legal
scripts.check: npm run lint && node --check src/main.js && node --check src/gateway.js && node --check src/media-server.js && node --check src/tray-controller.js && node --check src/obs.js && node --check src/runtime.js && node --check src/updater.js && node --check src/version.js && node --check src/telemetry.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/logger.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check scripts/env.js && node --check scripts/set-nightly-version.js && node --check scripts/write-worker-config.js && node --check scripts/write-build-info.js && node --check scripts/update-signature.js && node --check scripts/sign-update-metadata.js && node --check scripts/generate-update-signing-key.js && node --check scripts/local-update-server.js && node --check scripts/generate-app-icon.js && node --check scripts/build-source-bundle.js && node --check scripts/build-release.mjs && node --check scripts/release.mjs && node --check scripts/check-workers.mjs && node --check scripts/publish-github-release.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-public-release.mjs && node --check scripts/archive-release-background.mjs && node --check scripts/migrate-r2-sources-to-github.mjs && node --check clips-worker/scripts/publish-r2.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.js && npm run test:worker && node scripts/check-workers.mjs
scripts.test:worker: node --experimental-strip-types --test clips-worker/test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:integration --prefix clips-worker
scripts.dist: npm run build:info && npm run stage:legal && electron-builder --config electron-builder.update.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:staged: npm run build:info && npm run stage:legal && electron-builder --config electron-builder.staged.json --win dir && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-staged-update.ps1
scripts.dist:bootstrap: npm run build:info && npm run stage:legal && electron-builder --config electron-builder.bootstrap.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:fresh: npm run stage:runtime && npm run build:mpv-host && npm run build:capture-host && npm run dist:bootstrap
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:info && electron-builder --config electron-builder.bootstrap.json --win portable
